identified_issues: Violation of Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2.1: Breaker BKR_512 was actuated without an approved, pre-authorized Switching Order registered in DISPATCH_EMS prior to physical switching.

Violation of Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2.3: Switching execution was performed under unauthorized status; retrospective submission SO-2026-8812 cannot cure an unauthorized line disconnection.
Procedural non-compliance by substation field personnel initiating de-energization via manual trip prior to dispatch authorization.
evidence: DISPATCH_EMS registry log at 2026-10-06T15:45:00.000Z and 15:50:00.000Z confirmed 'No switching order on file for BKR_512' and 'Pre-authorization status: NONE'.
RELAY_SEL_451 event log confirmed physical trip pushbutton depression and BKR_512 opening at 2026-10-06T16:10:02.100Z–16:10:02.145Z with line current dropping to 0.0 A.
DISPATCH_EMS log entry EMS_LOG_9941 at 2026-10-06T16:12:15.000Z flagged retrospective submission as 'RETROSPECTIVE_UNAUTHORIZED' with 'Reference Order: NONE'.
recommended_action: Uphold the auditor infraction notice and record an audit failure for this switching action. Enforce mandatory interlocking or procedural hold points requiring verified dispatch switching order numbers before substation breaker manual tripping is permitted, and initiate a formal compliance review regarding unauthorized line de-energization.
